title: 第606章 前往旸谷大阵失效第605章 苦口婆心天蓬放弃
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
“佛门暂且搁置，不必再急于一时。”
玄朔负手而立，目光穿透重重云海，望向东海之极，语气沉稳而笃定。
“随本座往东海一趟，去往极东旸谷秘境。”
“旸谷乃上古金乌祖地，如今洪荒动荡，此地不宜再与世隔绝。本座昔年与帝俊、羲和有旧，此番前去，只为劝其族人迁出秘境、避劫安身。”
天蓬闻言，立刻敛去周身魔焰，躬身领命：“谨遵大帝之令。”
玄朔不再多言，袖袍一挥，携天蓬、黄眉二人踏空而起。三人化作一道流光，破开万重云海，径直朝东海极境飞驰而去。
——————————
东天之极，沧海尽处。洪荒最东隅之地，日升之源，古名旸谷。
自帝俊、太一纵横洪荒的妖庭时代开始，此地便是金乌嫡系栖息秘境。万古以来，外人罕至，仙佛不临，神魔止步，始终独立于洪荒纷争之外，守得一方安宁。
玄朔收束天河云辇，携天蓬、黄眉二人踏临东海极境。
极东的海风灼热炽盛，漫天游离的太阳精气蒸腾不休，整片空域充斥着最纯粹的先天大日道韵。
放眼望去，旸谷之外云海层层叠叠、金辉轮转不息，一座浩瀚无边的天地巨阵横亘山海，封锁整片秘境疆界。
正是太一昔年亲手布下的周天晨昏大阵。
此阵依托诸天太阳星力为根基，取晨昏轮转、日夜交替之理，周天大衍、循环不息。阵可隐秘境天机、蔽族群气息、御外敌杀伐、挡诸天窥探。
在上古时代，太阳、太阴两星未被帝江炼化之前，此阵乃是洪荒顶尖守护大阵，壁垒森严、圣人难破，唯有混元圣人方可强行窥破、撼动阵基。
只可惜，岁月流转，世事早已更迭。帝江昔年横推星辰本源，强行炼化太阳、太阴两大诸天主星，自此日月星力尽归帝江掌控。
失去本源星辰支撑的周天晨昏大阵，看似依旧金辉煌煌、轮转不止、威势赫赫，实则早已徒有其表、外强中干。
阵法框架尚在，阵道本源已空，循环法理残缺，再无半分上古镇狱之威。太一蛰伏万古、久不临世，全然不知自家祖地护山大阵早已名存实亡。
玄朔立在阵外，眸光淡淡扫过轮转不休的金色阵光，心中了然。
“走吧。”

话音落下，玄朔抬手一振。一柄古朴厚重、纯阳浩荡的神剑自袖中悬浮而出，剑身流转极致炽烈的先天纯阳道纹，剑气澄澈霸道、镇压万邪，正是帝江亲赐纯阳剑。
此剑承载帝江部分圣道本源，可斩虚妄、破迷障、蔽天机、镇阴阳。
嗡——！
纯阳剑轻鸣一声，一缕淡淡纯阳圣辉铺开，笼罩玄朔、天蓬、黄眉三人躯体。剑光照体，直接屏蔽三人所有气息、道韵、行踪、天机，完美绕过周天晨昏大阵残存的浅薄阵机。
content_en:
"Put Buddhism on hold for the time being, there is no need to rush."
Xuan Shuo stood with his hands behind his hands, looking through the sea of clouds to the extreme of the East China Sea, his tone was calm and determined.
"Follow me to the East China Sea, to the secret realm of Yanggu in the far east."
"Yang Valley is the ancestral land of the Golden Crow in ancient times. Nowadays, the prehistoric times are turbulent, and it is no longer suitable for this place to be isolated from the world. I had an old relationship with Emperor Jun and Xihe in the past, and I went here this time just to persuade their tribesmen to move out of the secret realm and avoid disaster."
Hearing this, Tianpeng immediately put away the demonic flames around him and bowed to accept the order: "I will obey the emperor's order."
Xuan Shuo said no more, waved his sleeves and robe, and took off with Tianpeng and Huang Mei into the air. The three people turned into a stream of light, breaking through the sea of ​​​​clouds, and flew straight towards the end of the East China Sea.
——————————
The end of the eastern sky, the end of the vast sea. The easternmost place in the prehistoric times, the source of the rising sun, was named Yang Valley in ancient times.
Since the time of Emperor Jun and Taiyi's reign in the Demon Court, this place has been the secret place where the direct descendants of the Golden Crow live. For all eternity, outsiders have rarely visited, immortals and Buddhas have not come, gods and demons have stopped, and they have always been independent from the conflicts of the ancient times and maintained peace.
Xuan Shuo gathered up the Tianhe Cloud Chariot and took Tianpeng and Huang Mei to the extreme realm of the East China Sea.
The sea breeze in the far east is scorching, the sun's essence is steaming all over the sky, and the entire airspace is filled with the purest innate charm of the Great Sun.
Looking around, outside Yanggu, there are layers of clouds and endless golden glow. A vast and boundless formation of heaven and earth stretches across the mountains and seas, sealing off the entire secret realm.
It was exactly the Zhoutian morning and evening formation that Taiyi personally laid out in the past.
This formation relies on the power of the sun and stars in the heavens as its foundation, and takes the principle of the cycle of morning and evening, the alternation of day and night, and the cycle of the sky is endless. The formation can conceal the heavenly secrets of the realm, shield the aura of the group, defend against the killings of external enemies, and block the prying eyes of the heavens.
In the ancient times, before the two stars of Sun and Taiyin were refined by Dijiang, this formation was the top protective formation of the ancient world. The barriers were so tight that it was difficult for saints to break through them. Only the Saints of Hunyuan could forcibly break through and shake the foundation of the formation.
It's a pity that as time goes by, things have changed. In the past, Dijiang pushed the source of the stars and forcibly refined the two main stars of the sun and taiyin. Since then, the power of the sun, moon and stars has been under Dijiang's control.
The Zhoutian morning and evening formation, which has lost the support of its original stars, still seems to be brilliant, rotating, and powerful, but in fact it has become nothing more than its appearance, strong on the outside but weak on the inside.
The framework of the formation is still there, the origin of the formation is empty, the principle of circulation is incomplete, and it no longer has half of the ancient power of suppressing the prison. Taiyi has been dormant for eternity and has not been around for a long time. He has no idea that his ancestral mountain protection formation has long existed in name only.
Xuan Shuo stood outside the formation, his eyes faintly scanning the endlessly rotating golden formation light, and he understood in his heart.
"Let's go."
After the words fell, Xuan Shuo raised his hand and shook his head. An ancient, thick, pure Yang mighty divine sword floated out of his sleeve. The extremely fiery innate pure Yang Dao patterns flowed through the sword body. The sword energy was clear and domineering, capable of suppressing all evils. It was the Pure Yang Sword given by Emperor Jiang himself.
This sword carries the origin of part of Dijiang's holy path, and can cut off illusions, break obstacles, conceal the secrets of heaven, and suppress yin and yang.
Buzz—!
The Pure Yang Sword chirped softly, and a faint ray of Pure Yang Holy Glory spread out, covering the bodies of Xuan Shuo, Tian Peng, and Huang Mei. The sword illuminates the body, directly blocking all the breath, Tao Yun, whereabouts, and heavenly secrets of the three people, and perfectly bypasses the remaining shallow formations of Zhoutian's morning and dusk formation.
